title: Environmental DNA (eDNA) 12S Metabarcoding Illumina MiSeq NGS PCR Protocol
author: Katie Pitz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcppivmn
materials: After secondary PCR, products were run through Invitrogen SequalPrep Normalization Plate (ThermoFisher Scientific) using manufacturer's protocol to create pooled library.
After secondary PCR, products were run through Invitrogen SequalPrep Normalization Plate (ThermoFisher Scientific) using manufacturer's protocol to create pooled library.

steps.title: Prepare primary PCR reaction mix
steps.instruction: Set up triplicate 25 µL primary PCRs in a 96‑well plate using 1 µL eDNA extract, 12.5 µL AmpliTaq Gold™ Fast PCR Master Mix, 1 µL forward primer (10 µM) and 1 µL reverse primer (10 µM) (MiFish_U primers with Fluidigm CS1/CS2 adapters: forward ACACTGACGACATGGTTCTACA GTCGGTAAAACTCGTGCCAGC, reverse TACGGTAGCAGAGACTTGGTCT CATAGTGGGGTATCTAATCCCAGTTTG), and 9.5 µL molecular‑grade nuclease‑free water. Include a no‑template control (NTC) on each plate (total 3 NTCs) and an artificial community as a positive control.

substeps.instruction: Dispense reagents into each well according to the volumes above.
Add NTC wells containing water instead of template.
Add positive‑control wells with artificial community DNA.

steps.title: Run primary PCR thermal program
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler with the CALeDNA Touchdown protocol: 95 °C 15 min; 13 touchdown cycles of 94 °C 30 s, 69.5 °C 30 s (decrease annealing temperature by 1.5 °C each cycle), 72 °C 90 s; then 25 cycles of 94 °C 30 s, 50 °C 30 s, 72 °C 45 s; finish with 72 °C 10 min and hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Pool primary PCR products and gel check
steps.instruction: Combine the triplicate reactions for each environmental sample to a total volume of 75 µL, then run the pooled product on a 2 % agarose gel to verify the presence of the expected 12S amplicon and the absence of non‑specific bands.

substeps.instruction: Pool the three 25 µL reactions per sample to 75 µL.
Prepare a 2 % agarose gel with appropriate DNA ladder.
Load pooled PCR product and run electrophoresis.
Visualize gel to confirm correct band size.

steps.title: Purify primary PCR products with AMPure beads
steps.instruction: Purify and size‑select the pooled primary PCR products using Agencourt AMPure XP beads at a 1.2× bead‑to‑sample volume ratio.

steps.title: Second gel verification and Qubit quantification
steps.instruction: Run a second 2 % agarose gel on the purified products to confirm removal of primers and retention of the target amplicon; additionally, assay the no‑template controls with a Qubit dsDNA High Sensitivity kit to ensure no contaminating DNA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare and run agarose gel with purified PCR samples.
Inspect gel for clean amplicon band and absence of primer dimers.
Measure DNA concentration of NTCs using Qubit HS kit.

steps.title: Prepare secondary PCR indexed primers
steps.instruction: Aliquot 20 µL of each purified primary PCR product and ship to the Michigan State University RTSF Genomics Core for secondary amplification using primers that anneal to the Fluidigm CS1/CS2 adapters and add dual‑indexed Illumina adapters.

substeps.instruction: Forward primer (PE1‑BC‑CS1): AATGATACGGCGACCACCGAGATCT‑[i5‑BC]‑ACACTGACGACATGGTTCTACA
Reverse primer (PE2‑BC‑CS2): CAAGCAGAAGACGGCATACGAGAT‑[i7‑BC]‑TACGGTAGCAGAGACTTGGTCT

steps.title: Set up secondary PCR reactions
steps.instruction: In 15 µL reactions combine 1 µL of the original pooled primary PCR product (triplicate), 6 µL 2.5× HotMaster Mix, 7 µL DI water, 1 µL Primer Mix (6 µM of the indexed primers), and 1 µL original eDNA PCR product.

steps.title: Run secondary PCR thermal program
steps.instruction: Thermocycle the secondary PCRs with: 95 °C 3 min; 15 cycles of 95 °C 15 s, 60 °C 30 s, 72 °C 1 min; followed by 72 °C 3 min and hold at 25 °C.

steps.title: Gel verification of secondary PCR
steps.instruction: Run an agarose gel on the secondary PCR products to confirm the presence of the target band, the absence of non‑specific amplification, and no amplification in the NTCs.

substeps.instruction: Prepare appropriate agarose gel.
Load secondary PCR products and NTCs.
Visualize to verify expected results.

steps.title: Pool secondary products and load MiSeq
steps.instruction: Pool the secondary PCR products, load the combined library onto a standard Illumina MiSeq v2 flow cell, and sequence in 2 × 250 bp paired‑end mode using a v2 500‑cycle reagent cartridge with a 10 % PhiX spike. Add primers complementary to Fluidigm CS1 & CS2 to the appropriate wells of the reagent cartridge for the sequencing and index reads.

substeps.instruction: Combine all secondary amplicons in equimolar amounts.
Prepare MiSeq run with v2 500‑cycle kit.
Spike library with 10 % PhiX control.
Load CS1/CS2 sequencing primers into cartridge wells.
Start 2 × 250 bp paired‑end sequencing.

steps.title: Perform base calling and demultiplexing
steps.instruction: Process the MiSeq run with Illumina Real‑Time Analysis (RTA) v1.18.54 for base calling, then demultiplex and convert the data to FASTQ files using Illumina bcl2fastq v2.18.0.

substeps.instruction: Run RTA v1.18.54 on the instrument.
Execute bcl2fastq v2.18.0 to generate demultiplexed FASTQ files.
